task: Classify a risk tier from a health factor given in tenths: hf=8 tenths (i.e. 0.8). Tiers: hf>=20 -> high, hf>=12 -> medium, hf>=10 -> low, below 10 -> liquidate. hf=8 classifies as liquidate. Store the string liquidate as answer. When achieved, finish with rlm_set(~~QT~~Final~~QT~~, true).
lesson: Today I learned the `if` form evaluates conditions left-to-right and short-circuits, so placing `>= 20` before `>= 12` incorrectly classifies 8 as ~~QT~~high~~QT~~.
